description: INFLUENCE — the status of a check request by id: queued, in_review, running, done, rejected or needs_info, with any notes shared by the reviewer. The id identifies the request, but the Influence plan is now required to read it back. To report an error for free, use report_correction or open an issue on the provider's api-evangelist repo. Priced B1 (single-entity synthesis) — $0.01 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

name: check_status
